documents.title: Travel policy
documents.text: Employees may claim up to $45 per day for meals during approved overnight business travel. Receipts are required for expenses over $10. The travel policy does not cover contractors.

documents.title: Expense procedure
documents.text: Submit expense reports within 14 calendar days after the trip ends. A manager must approve the report before Finance pays it. Finance pays approved reports in the next Friday payment batch.

documents.title: Support plans
documents.text: Standard support operates Monday through Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Eastern time, excluding company holidays. Premium support accepts critical incident reports 24 hours a day, every day. The target initial response for Premium critical incidents is one hour; this is not a guaranteed resolution time.

documents.title: Incident procedure
documents.text: For a critical incident, send the service identifier and impact summary to the support portal. Never send passwords or customer payment data. The on-call engineer assesses Premium critical incidents.

documents.title: Data handling
documents.text: Synthetic data may be used in public demonstrations. Real customer documents require written customer permission before being sent to an external AI service. Customer documents must not appear in public benchmark results.
